// Fractal (fBm) noise: base Frequency in cycles per UV tile, Octaves layers
// with Lacunarity frequency growth and Gain amplitude falloff per octave,
// deterministically seeded.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Brownian_motion)
type NoiseTexture
    implements IProceduralTexture
{
    Frequency: Number;
    Octaves: Integer;
    Lacunarity: Number;
    Gain: Number;
    Seed: Integer;
}
